features.title: Bring the windows of the wheel entry, exchanges, party, member and member removal to the mockup
Bring the player windows to the mockup: item use, spin payment, review
Implement the transfer of an item between players
Bring the wheel and members screens without a window to the mockup
Remove the wishlist delete window; show the removed games with a restore button
Remove the obtrusive captions everywhere after forms

Change the system parameters form (views/Admin/AdminParametersView.vue): add a data format to every parameter. The user's words: add a data format for each parameter. Today the texts of a parameter (label, hint, check) live in the descriptions map by name, and every value is checked as an integer. Open: what the format is (a type, a unit, an example shown to the admin) and where it comes from (the client or a backend field).

Move the catalog editing into the admin panel. The user's words: move the catalog editing into the admin panel. Today the catalog is a route of its own (RouteName.Catalog, views/Catalog/CatalogView.vue, the «Каталог» item in AppSidebar and an entry in composables/useTabs.ts), and the admin panel (routes under admin with meta.admin, its own sidebar) holds exchanges, wheel, rewards, members and parameters. Open: what happens to the «Каталог» item of the main sidebar and to the non-admin players (gone, or a read-only view).

Add a form for a player to choose their own color. The user's words: add a color choice form for the player. Today ColorPicker is reached only through FormDialog (type 'color'), in the party creation form and in the admin member edit form (AdminMembersView), so a player has no way to change their own color. Open: where the form lives (which screen or menu) and whether the admin can still change the color.

Remove the text from the «Сохранить» buttons. The user's words: remove the text from the Save buttons. The text is set in FormDialog (the default submitLabel), ReviewDialog, WishlistTab, AdminParametersView, AdminRewardsView, AdminSpinCost, and by submit-label in AdminExchangesView, AdminWheelView, CatalogEntryDialog and PartiesView. Open: what stays on the button (an icon only, such as the check icon AdminSpinCost already uses), which buttons count (every «Сохранить», or also «Создать пати», «Добавить пункт» and the like) and how a screen reader gets the name (aria-label).

Rework the tables so that they are more informative: some fields are not shown in them at all. The user's words: redo the tables, they must become more informative. The tables are in views/Admin (AdminMembersView, AdminWheelView, AdminExchangesView), Catalog/CatalogView, Users/UsersView, Games (CompletedTab, WishlistTab, UserWishlistTab) and Resources (PointsTab, SharedPointsTab, HistoryTab).

Fix the eye in the login and registration forms. The user's words, translated: «fix the eye in the authorization and registration forms». It is unclear what is broken. Known: views/Auth/AuthView.vue has the password and the repeat password as plain type="password" fields of UiInput, there is no show-password button of our own and no eye icon in assets/icons, so the eye in question is most likely the one the WebView draws itself in a password field (WebView2 on Windows). Open: what exactly is wrong with it (it does not show, it looks out of place, it is doubled, it hides the field error), on which system, and whether to keep the native eye or replace it with our own button.

Rework the form of the item entry rows to account for the special actions: transfer, copy and delete. The user's words, translated: «rework the form with the special actions in mind (transfer, copy, delete)». The form is components/RowsEditor.vue (the item-entry variant), used by views/Catalog/components/CatalogEntryDialog.vue for the entries of an item and of a perk ability, with the rows parsed in utils/formRows.ts (FormRow in components/formDialog.ts). Today a row is «Кто» (Владелец or Цель), «Действие» (Получает or Теряет, which is the sign of the amount), «Кол-во» and «Ресурс». The special actions are not actions of the form: they hide in the resource list as «Предмет на выбор» (a `user-item` entry: with the action «Получает» it copies the picked copies, with «Теряет» it takes them away, so «copy» and «delete» are the two signs of one resource) and as «Передать выбранный предмет» (a `user-item-transfer` entry: its action is fixed to «Передаёт», the amount has no sign, and «Кто» is the side that loses the copies). In the entry kinds of the backend (items.yaml and perks.yaml of https://api.fgg-challenge.com/scalar) these are `user_item` with a positive amount (copy), `user_item` with a negative amount (take away) and `user_item_transfer`. The use window (views/Resources/components/UseDialog.vue, slots in utils/itemUse.ts) already treats the three differently. Check the form against the documentation of the entry kinds and amounts.
Rename the wishlist in every text the user sees to «Список желаемого»
Replace the Tauri template icon of the app window with the FGG symbol

Express through the interface the rules that the removed captions of the members screen and its window stated. Removed: «Пустое имя — показывается логин», «Снять админа с себя нельзя», «Если из пати уходит последний админ, им становится тот, кто вступил раньше всех»; in the window «Пустое — покажем логин», «Меняет каталоги, колесо, награды и участников», «Из палитры или свой в виде #ffb000. Цвета могут повторяться». Ideas: the admin switch is disabled in the row of the user themself, with the reason on hover; the removal confirmation names who becomes the admin when the last one leaves; the name field shows the login as a placeholder (it already does); the admin switch shows what an admin may do on hover; a color that is not a hex gets an error under the field, not a toast. Open: which of these the user wants.

Express through the interface the rules that the removed captions of the rewards screen and of the spin cost card stated. Removed: «Длительность таймера меняется в «Системных параметрах»», «Новая награда действует только на следующие таймеры и игры, уже выданные не пересчитываются»; «Цена только у этой группы, у других своя», «Она списывается, когда игрок применяет результат, и действует на следующие прокруты», «Если у игрока предметов больше, чем нужно, он сам выбирает, какие списать». Ideas: a link from the timer reward card to the parameters; a mark «с следующего таймера» on a card after a save instead of a toast; the title of the cost card carries the group name; the choice of copies is shown as a switch in the cost form, as in the other «Игрок выбирает» switches. Open: which of these the user wants.

Express through the interface the rules that the removed captions of the admin wheel screen and its entry window stated. Removed under the table: «Не повторять выпавшее» (an entry does not fall again until the others have), «Вручную» (the player enters the changes after the spin), «Выпавшая игра становится текущей», «Enter в строке внизу добавляет игру и оставляет строку для следующей»; in the window the hints of «Остальное игрок вносит сам» and «Игрок выбирает, что применить». Ideas: the placeholder of the add-row says «Название игры, Enter — добавить»; a switch that has a rule gets an info mark with the text on hover or focus (one shared component for every switch of the app that carried a hint); the group tab of a games group shows what a fallen game does as a quiet line in its header. Open: which of these the user wants.

Express through the interface the rules that the removed captions of the exchanges screens stated. Removed: for the player «Пунктирная рамка — ресурса не хватает, в скобках сколько есть. Обмен недоступен, пока не хватает хотя бы одного»; for the admin «Обе стороны — список изменений, как в «Выдать»», «Удалённый обмен скрывается у игроков, история сохраняется», and the hints of both «Игрок выбирает» switches. Ideas: a dashed pill gets a hover text «не хватает 2, есть 1» and the card says once why the exchange is unavailable, as it already does for a perk the player owns; the delete confirmation of an exchange says that players stop seeing it and the history stays; the switches use the shared info mark of rules-ui-wheel-admin. Open: which of these the user wants.

Express through the interface the rules that the removed hints of the catalog window stated. Removed: «Свои или общие на пати — выбирается один раз, потом не изменить» (scope of a point type), «Цель игрок выберет сам, когда применит предмет», the hints of both «Игрок выбирает, что применить» switches (item and perk ability), «Способность не меняется после создания: от неё зависит состояние у всех владельцев. Нужна другая — создай новый перк», «Столько событий, заряжающих способность, дают одно использование. 0 — зарядов нет». Ideas: after creation the scope field is shown locked, as the limits of an existing ability already are, with a lock icon and the reason on hover; the locked ability tab has a lock in its title; the charges field gets a unit text after the number («событий на одно использование»); the info mark of rules-ui-wheel-admin on the switches. Open: which of these the user wants.

Express through the interface the rules that the removed captions of the player screens stated. Removed: the list of players «Очки, предметы и эффекты — в профиле игрока. Нажми на строку, чтобы его открыть»; the shared points «Общие очки принадлежат всей пати. Менять их можно только ручной формой»; the completed games «Оценку и отзыв видят все в пати. Свой отзыв можно поправить в любой момент»; the manual change form, the fix note («Исходная запись не меняется: исправление попадёт в журнал новой записью…») and the plain note («Было → станет» считается по текущим ресурсам игрока, записью с меткой «вручную»). Ideas: a row of the players table gets a chevron and a hover state to show that it opens; the shared points table gets a button to the manual form for admins only; the review window title says who sees the review; the fix window shows the original journal entry as a quiet card above the rows, and the «Было → станет» column head carries the explanation on hover. Open: which of these the user wants.

Express through the interface the rules that the removed hints of the party window stated. Removed: «Последний день входит в пати. После него она завершится», «Цвет твоего аватара в этой пати. Админ потом может его поменять». Ideas: the period field shows the end date as «до 30 ноября включительно» next to the count of days; the color field shows an avatar preview with the login in the chosen color. Open: which of these the user wants.
